Request for the ALJ’s to deny Applicants request to strike Intervenor Testimonies

       To the Honorable Cassandra Quinn, Dee Marlo Chico and Lindra Brite
                              Administrative Law Judges.

On 5/18/2026 the Applicant filed #4726 to have certain internevors testimonies removed

from the hearings for reasons of Hearsay: Non-expert opinion. We are self representing

ourselves and are not lawyers. We answered the questions on the testimony form to the

best of our ability and may have referenced an article or study to support our belief and

concerns. I object to striking our complete testimony and having it removed just

because one or two answers were referencing information that the Applicant feels is a

Non-expert opinion. The answers in question can be stricken but not the complete

testimony. We are trying to defend our homes and property and our voices need to be

heard. So I respectfully request that the ALJ’s to deny the applicants request to strike

the internenors testimony before the hearings, and/or allow the affected intervenors a

                                             {David Rosenkranz and Barbara Wright-Rosenkranz}
                                                                       PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                               SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349

 chance to submit a revised testimony removing the statements in question. David

Rosenkranz and Barbara Wright-Rosenkranz internvenor #3942.
